method: Unedited viewport screenshots of the public application in a fresh Chrome browser context. All actions used ordinary UI controls. Only the supplied fictional example workbook was downloaded and changed locally. No DOM decoration, altered screenshots, customer data, external uploads or shared publication.
useCase: Identify firms for a tracing inquiry

app.name: Review food-traceability evidence
app.case: Supplied fictional FOOD-MINI-1 case; no real investigation or operational authorization.

steps: Open Marketplace and inspect its collection cards.
Open Food supply chains collection details.
Install collection; its exact release opens in Collections.
Use app; inspect the supplied fictional case in Both layout.
Download Excel; change only Parameters!D2, Firm to review, from F11 (Pacific Market) to F09 (Lake Market); Upload Excel and review the one-value change.
Apply inputs, then inspect Reports / Findings / Firm inclusion.
Return to Collections, open Food supply chains, expand Saved cases and Resume case.
Select Both and Start another case; verify an independent ID and unchanged published defaults.
